comparison_family.adjustment_scope: once over the 36; when a stratum is unavailable, once over the available tests
comparison_family.aggregation: origins averaged within series and horizon; series weighted equally; series are the pairing and bootstrap units

authority.commit_note: The commit containing the addition and this file is the registration; it did not exist when this file was written and is recorded by the signed readiness document before the gate.

comparison_family.direction: variant minus reference; negative favors the variant; the direction is read from the median and reported beside the mean
comparison_family.hypothesis: H3: on series whose context zero fraction is at least 0.5 the substitution with a dynamic occurrence lowers QScore9 relative to the model's own completed forecast; below 0.5 it raises it. Each stratum is tested on its own; nothing is pooled across strata for confirmation.
comparison_family.order: stratum (dense, sparse, very sparse), model, horizon (7, 30), contrast (T1, T2)
comparison_family.strata_rule: sampling strata, computed on the context zero fraction of 2026-03-05 through 2026-06-02 only
comparison_family.unavailable_rule: A stratum with fewer than ten complete series makes its twelve tests unavailable; they are reported as unavailable and the family is not shrunk by any outcome.

pit.derivation: Each saved forecast with a count law per target day draws its uniforms from numpy.random.default_rng(pulsegraph.random.derived_seed(20261003, 'study3', domain, series_id, cutoff, horizon, model)); V = rng.random(horizon), one uniform per target day in lead order; U = F(y-) + V (F(y) - F(y-)) with F(y-) = 1 - SF(y - 1) and F(y) = 1 - SF(y) of the saved law. Ten equal bins on [0, 1], the last closed. Raw native deciles, local_mean_28 and autoets_weekly have no full count law, and their PIT is unavailable.

secondary.status: secondary; no adjustment except the within-table BH column of the pooled table in Study 2's form; never replaces the family

adjustment.scope: once over the available tests of the family

settings.aggregation: origins within series and horizon, then equal series within the stratum
settings.availability: a stratum with fewer than 10 complete series has its twelve tests unavailable; BH once over the available tests

bootstrap.derivation: Each comparison's bootstrap seed is pulsegraph.random.derived_seed(20261004, 'study3', comparison id, stratum, variant, reference, horizon, metric): Study 2's derivation (the first four bytes, little-endian, of the SHA-256 of json.dumps([root, component, id, ...], sort_keys=True, allow_nan=False)) with the component name study3, the stratum in the place of the domain and the variant in the place of the model; the root and the horizon are integers, every other field a string. A pooled secondary row has the stratum 'all'; a secondary row's id is 'stratum/variant/reference/h<horizon>', or P01 to P18 for the pooled table in Study 2's form. The generator is numpy.random.default_rng(seed).
bootstrap.draws: rng.integers(0, n, size=(block, n)) in blocks of 256

settings.difference: variant minus reference; negative favors the variant
settings.direction: the median's sign, reported beside the mean; H3's sign beside T1 rows
